We'll check availability for a 13-tonne excavator to run alongside your other sites — let us know the dates you need it for and we'll get back to you as soon as we've confirmed what's free.

We haven't forgotten it and will come back to you as soon as we hear back from them.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
